title: Ribbon Levels for Navbar Tabs and Window Toolbar
description: Expand the design language with ribbon levels: a ribbon strip that grows by stacked lines, one per tree level. Navbar shrinks to two toggles (left/right side panel visibility); the former panel-kind categories (workbench/display, details/settings) become the top tab row of each side panel, with plugin tabs as a row below — tabs are now a tree, arbitrarily nestable (plugin schema becomes recursive too). Window toolbar tool-group nodes expand the ribbon upward (one stacked line per pressed group, sibling press replaces rows above). Footer keeps its inline horizontal drill-down (no vertical room to grow). See plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/ui-the-design-language-quirky-sifakis.md and detailed design at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/ui-the-design-language-quirky-sifakis-agent-a74768b944cee9bef.md.
summary:
Implemented ribbon levels across the design language:

**Navbar → two toggles.** `panelToggles` in os-shell.tsx now has exactly `ui.panelToggle.left`/`ui.panelToggle.right` (panel-left/panel-right icons, tied to leftPanelVisible/rightPanelVisible). Added the two i18n keys to the ui/react translation schema + de + en tables atomically.

**Side-panel nested tab tree.** New `PanelTabNode` discriminated union (`kind: "leaf" | "branch"`) replaces the flat `SidePanelTabConfig` in ui/js/react/index.tsx. `PanelTabBar` walks the tree and stacks one `PanelTabRow` per level via a new `Ribbon` primitive (`direction="down"`). `SidePanel`/`MobilePanel` now take `activeTabPath`/`onActiveTabPathChange` (string-array paths) instead of a single `activeTabId`. New generic `reconcileActivePath` helper (keeps matching segments, falls back to first sibling, auto-descends to a leaf). os-shell.tsx builds category root branches (`framework.category.workbench/display/details/settings`) whose children are the existing plugin tab lists, recursively converted from the now-recursive `AppPanelTabDefinition` via `panelTabDefinitionToNode`; `flattenPanelTabLeaves` centralizes leaf lookup for rendering/search. Studio deep-linking (`panel.activePanelTab`) is preserved via `findPanelTabPath`.

**Window toolbar ribbon stacking.** `ToolbarRibbonSegment` now carries `depth` on every segment; `ToolTree` gained a `direction` prop (`"inline"` default for the footer, `"up"` for window toolbars) that groups segments by depth into `Ribbon` rows — pressing a collection expands a new line above the base row, sibling presses replace the rows above. Window toolbar chrome CSS (`windowToolbarBodyClass`, the `window-toolbar` container) updated to grow upward instead of clipping at a fixed height.

**Recursive Rust schema.** `PanelTabDefinition` (framework/core/rs) gained `children: Vec<PanelTabDefinition>` and optional `body_key`. `AppBuilder`/`PanelTabSpec` (framework/plugin/rs) got `PanelTabSpec::leaf`/`::group` + `.panel_tab_tree(...)`, keeping the old 4-arg `.panel_tab(...)` leaf shorthand source-compatible; added recursive id-uniqueness/exactly-one-of validation. Added a real nested demo (Document → Content/Outline) to writer/plugin/rs to exercise the runtime path end-to-end. Fixed the wgpu renderer's own `PanelTabDefinition` literals and its `refresh_ui` render loop (now flattens leaves) to match the new schema.

**Tests & stories.** Extended in-file test regions in ui/js/react/index.tsx (Ribbon, reconcileActivePath, multi-row PanelTabBar, panelToggle.left/right i18n, fixed pre-existing PanelTabBar/SidePanel tests to the new shape) and framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts (segment depth, upward ribbon stacking, flattenPanelTabLeaves). Added a jsdom `scrollIntoView` polyfill to vitest.setup.ts (pre-existing gap the new tests exposed). Updated Navbar/Toolbar/Panel/Layout Storybook stories (two-toggle navbar demo, Ribbon inline-vs-up demo, nested-tabs demo, plus fixed stale `SidePanel` tab fixtures that predated this change).

Verification: full-workspace `tsc --noEmit` and `cargo check --workspace` show zero errors touching any of the above; ui/js/react vitest (223 tests, 217 pass — 6 pre-existing unrelated Tree-component failures from concurrent work), framework/renderer/react vitest (81 tests, all pass), writer-plugin cargo test (27 tests, all pass). Live browser verification (os dev preview, Storybook) was attempted but blocked by two unrelated, already-in-flight concurrent issues, flagged separately: a broken `vcs` crate API (task_88684763) and a stale `host-shim.js` missing a `backbonePoll` export that prevents any plugin from loading in the dev preview (task_1d24453b). The Storybook story index did confirm all new/updated stories compile and register correctly.

Coda and sketchpad (compose) were checked and left untouched — neither consumes `PanelToggleGroup`/`SidePanel`/`PanelTabBar` from `@semio-tech/ui-react`, so there was nothing to update there.
